### Observed differences

- Activity A02 was not observed at all in the earlier window — 0 of 200 traces, mean 0 occurrences per trace. In the later window, A02 occurs exactly once in every trace (200 of 200, mean 1.0, no repetitions). [OCC001]
- In the earlier window, A05 appeared in all 200 traces at a constant mean position of 1.0 and had no observed outgoing transitions. In the later window, all of A05's observed outgoing flow leads to A02 — A05 is directly followed by A02 in every observed case. [DIR001, POS002]
- The relationship between the two activities flipped completely: earlier, A05 appeared without A02 in 100% of traces; in the later window, both occur together in 100% of traces, always in the order A05 before A02. [REL001]
- The positional profiles match this: A02 now holds a constant mean position of 1.0 — the position A05 alone occupied before — while A05's mean position moved to about 0.85 (median about 0.86) with a small spread. [POS001, POS002]

All five items describe one coherent pattern rather than independent differences. Each difference is larger than in about 199 of 200 random re-splits of the pooled data, and 5 items qualified against roughly 0.06 expected by chance for the 12 tested control-flow units — far beyond what an unchanged process typically produces. [OCC001, DIR001, POS001, POS002, REL001]

### Inference

Support level: Supported hypothesis

The evidence supports the hypothesis that A02 became a newly executed, mandatory step that runs once per case directly after A05: in the earlier window, A02 never appeared and A05 closed every trace at a constant position with no outgoing flow; in the later window, every trace runs A05 and then A02, with A02 taking over the position A05 previously held alone. [OCC001, DIR001, REL001, POS001, POS002]

Supporting signs: A02's participation went from 0 to 200 of 200 traces; the A05→A02 transition carries all of A05's observed outgoing flow; the relational profile moved from "A05 only" to "A05 before A02" in 100% of traces; and the positional shifts are consistent with A02 being placed immediately after A05. The screening result also backs this: 5 control-flow items qualified where about 0.06 would be expected if nothing had changed, far more than chance would produce. [OCC001, DIR001, POS001, POS002, REL001]

Limitations: the five items all reflect the same underlying trace change, so they are not independent confirmations; zero participation in the earlier window shows only that A02 was not observed there; and only the tested units are covered, so any other predecessors or successors of A02 are invisible. A competing explanation the evidence cannot fully rule out is that A02 already existed in the process but was executed too rarely to appear in the 200 earlier traces — behaviourally, however, it now runs in every trace where it previously ran in none. [OCC001, REL001]
